title: DoorBot: Closed-Loop Task Planning and Manipulation for Door Opening in the Wild with Haptic Feedback
summary: A closed-loop door-opening system that uses haptic feedback to verify outcomes and repair visually generated plans.

mechanisms.name: Haptic closed-loop door-function verification
mechanisms.description: Uses contact feedback after an action to distinguish visual plan plausibility from actual latch, handle, and door response, then replans when the outcome disagrees.
mechanisms.limitations: Requires a robot and contact sensing; success on 20 unseen doors does not establish phone-only sensing, safe human passage, or general door coverage.
